content.outro: The ferry pulls away from Saltlow. Nobody is left on the street to watch it go.
content.premise: Saltlow was a herring town until the shoals moved off. In the autumn its people loaded every cart they had and went inland, and they took everything that would carry. One man stayed on for one more tide: Ansel Tarrow, who keeps the ferry, and who will not sail without the parcel his sister left behind.
content.theme: A fishing street emptied for the winter, and the one thing in it left on purpose.
content.title: The Stripped Town
